critical_variable: second argument of kzalloc (the gfp_t flag) at line 515 in tipc_bcast_init()
path_conditions: The enclosing function tipc_bcast_init() is an initialization function reached only from process context (TIPC module init via tipc_init_net), never from interrupt/softirq context, and is not invoked while holding any spinlock or with preemption disabled. Therefore GFP_ATOMIC is unnecessary and wastes the atomic reserve.
rationale: Classic delay-gfp pattern: allocation site uses GFP_ATOMIC but the caller chain establishes that the function never executes in atomic context (initialization path, no spinlocks held, no IRQ/softirq, no RCU read side). The fix replaces GFP_ATOMIC with GFP_KERNEL so the allocator may sleep and tap the normal reserve.
